implementation: Plain PyTorch/cuBLAS/cuSOLVER/ATen and PyTorch flash-attention kernel; no custom Triton definitions or compiler patches.
current_input_learning: Current train rows/labels determine LDA, QDA Fisher metric, power transform, current class-seeded k-means, low-margin hard-row selection, weighted centroids, landmark preconditioner and fresh five-step PCG with extrapolated last direction. Query rows are only scaled, transformed and scored; no query labels or external data access.
input_integrity: Entry clones input tensors and only writes owned static copies. All later in-place operations target concatenations, factors, current fit buffers or owned temporaries; no writes through caller tensor views. Returned labels are cloned.
cached_state_reset: _C caches only identity/zero/one/index/algorithm constants. _ST caches streams and _GRAPHS caches shape/dtype/device keyed full-fit graphs plus owned input/output buffers. Every replay recomputes all data-dependent metric, clustering, weighted support, preconditioner and PCG state. PCG residual starts from current targets; every D/G slot is initialized before final reduction.
stream_integrity: High-priority preconditioner stream waits for current main-stream landmarks and factors; main stream waits for side completion before PCG. Both side chains fork and rejoin the captured main graph; no work is hidden after return or outside timed graph replay.
warmup: Two eager fits initialize kernels/constants, then full run is captured; 64 full-fit warmup replays and synchronize precede normal copy/full-refit/clone path. Same algorithm on foreign warmup and timed/energy draws; no dataset identity, timer or parent-process introspection.
pretrained_prior_review: All literals are algorithm/hyperparameter scalars and metadata text; no encoded arrays, pretrained weights, decoder, file/network IO or scorer/sandbox access.
upstream: Source and report explicitly credit @sigkillme0 #125 Fisher/compression/FITC/extrapolation/warmup method, own accepted rfm-pcg-d2 and inherited @islamborghini kernel-PCG. The new implementation uses triangular preconditioner solves, fewer PyTorch kernels, stream scheduling and retuned constants. Does not claim #125 Triton/HKNN code reuse.
published_rules: Canonical mnist-a100/1.2.0 D2 mean error<=3.40%, worst draw<=4.90%, holdout>=15%, complete11 MNIST+4 foreign calls plus all canonical clock/dispersion/sandbox gates; three official stock Modal runs and median. Optional energy validity separate. No new mandatory second-reviewer-batch or permanent source ban rule imposed.
